chose: A too-large refusal is held until what it is made with changes (its input, its caps, the render image, the speaker's image, the worker script or the brand files), the same as a too-long one.
options: hold only too-long (decided before anything is recorded); too-large keeps the hourly retry
gray: The ask named refusals decided before anything is recorded; too-large is decided after a full render, so each hourly retry costs the most, but ffmpeg's output size for the same input is deterministic only in practice.
undo: In render-calls.sh `failed_recently`, don't hold a refusal whose reason is too-large (it keeps the hourly retry), and drop the call week's hold checks from the too-large test case; keep recording the refusal, which the board reads to say why.
